<jats:title>Abstract</jats:title>
               <jats:p>In the first three sections of this chapter we briefly consider certain Hilbert spaces of holomorphic functions which form a natural generalization of the Bergman space. They are of interest from the viewpoint of representation theory, since the group G(D) has natural unitary representations acting on them. We do not give a very exhaustive discussion of these results since they are special cases of results for arbitrary bounded symmetric domains. In the final section we discuss Poisson transforms of functions defined on the Shilov boundary and we prove that they satisfy the so called Hua differential equations. The results of this section are special to the tube-type case; they do not extend in a simple way to the general case.</jats:p>
title: Function Spaces On Symmetric Domains Of Tube Type
